en.title: Customize stack · CLAUDE.md → skills → subagents → MCP/hooks
en.description: Step the Agent Capability Map: standing rules, a reusable skill, a bounded subagent, then MCP read-only context with hooks — without API keys.

steps.content: Turn my AetherBOT habits into the smallest useful workflow: CLAUDE.md rules, a create-concept-card skill, a research subagent, and read-only MCP — with a human gate before any write.
steps.annotation: Same vehicle as solos A6–A13. Stack is additive.

steps.content: Layer 1 — CLAUDE.md: standing rules every fresh session must know without an oral re-brief.
steps.annotation: CLAUDE.md — always-on project instructions.

steps.content: {"file":"CLAUDE.md","rules":["Never invent glossary sources","Stop for human approval before writing files","Say OPEN instead of guessing"]}
steps.annotation: ≥3 own rules. Permissions are separate from CLAUDE.md.

steps.content: {"wrote":"CLAUDE.md","rules":3,"fresh_session_ready":true}
steps.annotation: A new session should follow these without you retyping them.

steps.content: STACK UP · CLAUDE.md → skill — promote the method you keep re-explaining into .claude/skills/…
steps.annotation: skills — reusable method, not a daemon.

steps.content: {"path":".claude/skills/create-concept-card/SKILL.md","requires":["approved sources","OPEN on uncertainty","human OK before write"]}
steps.annotation: Skill encodes the create-concept-card method (Assignment 9).

steps.content: {"skill":"create-concept-card","tested_against":"approved cards","status":"ready"}
steps.annotation: Skill describes the method; it does not start Claude by itself.

steps.content: STACK UP · skill → subagent — when a role should stay bounded (e.g. research-only), give it a subagent with a tight brief.
steps.annotation: subagents — even if the deck lacks a slide, the stack still teaches them.

steps.content: {"role":"research","brief":"Find candidate sources for one term; do not write files; return OPEN gaps","bound":"read_only"}
steps.annotation: Subagent = scoped specialist run, not a second unrestricted Claude.

steps.content: {"role":"research","candidates":2,"OPEN":["paywalled PDF"],"wrote_files":false}
steps.annotation: Bounded output. Parent agent + human still own the write gate.

steps.content: STACK UP · subagent → MCP/hooks — pull authorized read-only context; hooks stop disallowed actions.
steps.annotation: MCP = connected context. Hooks = stop/allow gates.

steps.content: {"connection":"approved_jira","op":"get_issue","id":"WL-DAYSTART","mutate":false}
steps.annotation: Assignment 12 pattern — one authorized item, read-only.

steps.content: {"id":"WL-DAYSTART","summary":"Triage morning queue","actions_available_not_approved":["transition","comment"],"fetched":"read_only"}
steps.annotation: Name what the connection could do that you did not approve.

steps.content: {"hook":"PreToolUse","block":["Bash(rm*)","mcp__jira__transition"],"allow":["Read","mcp__jira__get_issue"]}
steps.annotation: hooks — technical gates beside CLAUDE.md rules.

steps.content: {"blocked":"mcp__jira__transition","allowed":"get_issue","human_checkpoint":"before any write"}
steps.annotation: Hooks enforce bounds; humans still approve writes.

steps.content: Smallest useful team workflow: CLAUDE.md rules → create-concept-card skill → research subagent → MCP read-only day-start brief → human checkpoint. Ready as a Workshop 6 use-case seed.
steps.annotation: Capability map closed.

nl.title: Customize-stack · CLAUDE.md → skills → subagents → MCP/hooks
nl.description: Stap de Agent Capability Map: vaste regels, een herbruikbare skill, een begrensde subagent, daarna MCP read-only context met hooks — zonder API-sleutels.

steps.content: Maak van mijn AetherBOT-gewoontes de kleinste nuttige workflow: CLAUDE.md-regels, een create-concept-card-skill, een research-subagent en read-only MCP — met een menselijke gate vóór elke write.
steps.annotation: Zelfde voertuig als solos A6–A13. De stack is additief.

steps.content: Laag 1 — CLAUDE.md: vaste afspraken die elke verse sessie moet kennen zonder mondelinge heruitleg.
steps.annotation: CLAUDE.md — altijd-aan projectinstructies.

steps.content: {"file":"CLAUDE.md","rules":["Verzin nooit glossary-bronnen","Stop voor menselijk akkoord vóór je bestanden schrijft","Zeg OPEN in plaats van te gokken"]}
steps.annotation: ≥3 eigen regels. Permissies zijn iets anders dan CLAUDE.md.

steps.content: {"wrote":"CLAUDE.md","rules":3,"fresh_session_ready":true}
steps.annotation: Een nieuwe sessie moet dit volgen zonder dat jij het opnieuw typt.

steps.content: STACK UP · CLAUDE.md → skill — promoveer de methode die je steeds opnieuw uitlegt naar .claude/skills/…
steps.annotation: skills — herbruikbare methode, geen daemon.

steps.content: {"path":".claude/skills/create-concept-card/SKILL.md","requires":["goedgekeurde bronnen","OPEN bij onzekerheid","menselijk OK vóór write"]}
steps.annotation: Skill legt de create-concept-card-methode vast (opdracht 9).

steps.content: {"skill":"create-concept-card","tested_against":"goedgekeurde kaarten","status":"ready"}
steps.annotation: Een skill beschrijft de methode; hij start Claude Code niet zelf.

steps.content: STACK UP · skill → subagent — als een rol begrensd moet blijven (bijv. alleen research), geef die een subagent met een strakke brief.
steps.annotation: subagents — ook als de deck geen dia heeft, leert de stack ze wél.

steps.content: {"role":"research","brief":"Zoek kandidaatbronnen voor één term; schrijf geen bestanden; lever OPEN-gaten","bound":"read_only"}
steps.annotation: Subagent = begrensde specialistenrun, geen tweede onbegrensde Claude.

steps.content: {"role":"research","candidates":2,"OPEN":["paywalled PDF"],"wrote_files":false}
steps.annotation: Begrensde output. Parent-agent + mens houden de write-gate.

steps.content: STACK UP · subagent → MCP/hooks — haal geautoriseerde read-only context op; hooks stoppen niet-toegestane acties.
steps.annotation: MCP = verbonden context. Hooks = stop/allow-gates.

steps.content: {"connection":"approved_jira","op":"get_issue","id":"WL-DAYSTART","mutate":false}
steps.annotation: Patroon opdracht 12 — één geautoriseerd item, read-only.

steps.content: {"id":"WL-DAYSTART","summary":"Triage ochtendwachtrij","actions_available_not_approved":["transition","comment"],"fetched":"read_only"}
steps.annotation: Benoem wat de verbinding wél kan wat jij niet goedkeurde.

steps.content: {"hook":"PreToolUse","block":["Bash(rm*)","mcp__jira__transition"],"allow":["Read","mcp__jira__get_issue"]}
steps.annotation: hooks — technische gates naast CLAUDE.md-regels.

steps.content: {"blocked":"mcp__jira__transition","allowed":"get_issue","human_checkpoint":"vóór elke write"}
steps.annotation: Hooks handhaven grenzen; mensen keuren writes nog steeds goed.

steps.content: Kleinste nuttige teamworkflow: CLAUDE.md-regels → create-concept-card-skill → research-subagent → MCP read-only day-start-brief → menselijk checkpoint. Klaar als use-case-zaadje voor Workshop 6.
steps.annotation: Capability map gesloten.
